name: Eclipse BaSyx
description: Industry 4.0 Asset Administration Shell implementation for digital twins. Provides off-the-shelf server/client SDKs with REST APIs for AAS and submodel interaction, supporting InMemory and MongoDB backends.

docker_support.docker_evidence: The docker images for the components from the Java SDK are provided on DockerHub, and there is no need for building them before usage.

eval_notes: Industry 4.0 digital twin standard (AAS). Pre-built Docker images on DockerHub. Could model network equipment as assets with standardized administration shells. REST APIs enable programmatic twin management for agentic scenarios.
